ayahs.arabicText: طٰسٓ١۫ تِلْكَ اٰیٰتُ الْقُرْاٰنِ وَ كِتَابٍ مُّبِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Ta'. Sin. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a Clear Book;

ayahs.arabicText: هُدًى وَّ بُشْرٰى لِلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: a guidance and good tidings for the believers

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ یُقِیْمُوْنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَ یُؤْتُوْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَ هُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ یُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: who establish Prayer and give Zakah, and have firm faith in the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ زَیَّنَّا لَهُمْ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ یَعْمَهُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds seem attractive to them so they stumble around in perplexity.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ لَهُمْ سُوْٓءُ الْعَذَابِ وَ هُمْ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الْاَخْسَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is they for whom a grievous chastisement lies in store; it is they who shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى الْقُرْاٰنَ مِنْ لَّدُنْ حَكِیْمٍ عَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: As for you, (O Muhammad), you are receiving the Qur'an from the Most Wise, the All-Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ مُوْسٰى لِاَهْلِهٖۤ اِنِّیْۤ اٰنَسْتُ نَارًا١ؕ سَاٰتِیْكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوْ اٰتِیْكُمْ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (Recount to them) when Moses said to his family: "I perceive something like fire: soon will I bring to you some information from there, or I will bring you a burning brand that you may warm yourselves."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُوْدِیَ اَنْۢ بُوْرِكَ مَنْ فِی النَّارِ وَ مَنْ حَوْلَهَا١ؕ وَ سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But when Moses came to the fire, a call was sounded: "Blessed is He Who is in the fire and whatever is around it. Glory be to Allah, the Sustainer of all in the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰمُوْسٰۤى اِنَّهٗۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ الْعَزِیْزُ الْحَكِیْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: O Moses, verily this is Me, Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَلْقِ عَصَاكَ١ؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَّلّٰى مُدْبِرًا وَّ لَمْ یُعَقِّبْ١ؕ یٰمُوْسٰى لَا تَخَفْ١۫ اِنِّیْ لَا یَخَافُ لَدَیَّ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَۗۖ
ayahs.translation: Now cast your rod!" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent, he turned his back in retreat and did not even look behind. "O Moses, have no fear. Messengers have no fear in My presence,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوْٓءٍ فَاِنِّیْ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: except he who has committed some wrong. But if he substitutes good in place of evil, I am Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَدْخِلْ یَدَكَ فِیْ جَیْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَیْضَآءَ مِنْ غَیْرِ سُوْٓءٍ١۫ فِیْ تِسْعِ اٰیٰتٍ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ قَوْمِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Now put your hand into your bosom, and it will come forth shining without any blemish. (These are two of the) nine Signs to be carried to Pharaoh and his people. They are surely a wicked people."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ اٰیٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوْا هٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌۚ
ayahs.translation: But when Our Clear Signs came to them, they said: "This is plain magic."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَحَدُوْا بِهَا وَ اسْتَیْقَنَتْهَاۤ اَنْفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَّ عُلُوًّا١ؕ فَانْظُرْ كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: They denied those Signs out of iniquity and arrogance although their hearts were convinced of their truth. So see how evil was the end of those mischief-makers!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا دَاوٗدَ وَ سُلَیْمٰنَ عِلْمًا١ۚ وَ قَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ فَضَّلَنَا عَلٰى كَثِیْرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (On the other hand), We granted knowledge to David and Solomon and they said: "All praise be to Allah Who has exalted us above many of His believing servants!"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَرِثَ سُلَیْمٰنُ دَاوٗدَ وَ قَالَ یٰۤاَیُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الطَّیْرِ وَ اُوْتِیْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ١ؕ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: And Solomon succeeded David and said: "O people, we have been taught the speech of birds and we have been endowed with all kinds of things. Surely this is a conspicuous favour (from Allah)."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ حُشِرَ لِسُلَیْمٰنَ جُنُوْدُهٗ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنْسِ وَ الطَّیْرِ فَهُمْ یُوْزَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Hosts of jinn and humans and birds were marshalled for Solomon and were kept under full control.

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَتَوْا عَلٰى وَادِ النَّمْلِ١ۙ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ یّٰۤاَیُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوْا مَسٰكِنَكُمْ١ۚ لَا یَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَیْمٰنُ وَ جُنُوْدُهٗ١ۙ وَ هُمْ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (Solomon was once on the move with them) until when they reached a valley of ants one of the ants said: "O ants, get into your holes, lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under their feet) without even knowing."

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّنْ قَوْلِهَا وَ قَالَ رَبِّ اَوْزِعْنِیْۤ اَنْ اَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِیْۤ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَیَّ وَ عَلٰى وَالِدَیَّ وَ اَنْ اَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضٰىهُ وَ اَدْخِلْنِیْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِیْ عِبَادِكَ الصّٰلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Smiling at the ant's utterance, Solomon burst into laughter and said: "My Lord! Hold me under (Your) control that I may render thanks for the favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may act righteously in a manner that would please You. Include me, out of Your Mercy, among Your righteous servants."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَفَقَّدَ الطَّیْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِیَ لَاۤ اَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ١ۖ٘ اَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَآئِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (On another occasion) Solomon inspected the birds and said: "Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Is he among the absentees?

ayahs.arabicText: لَاُعَذِّبَنَّهٗ عَذَابًا شَدِیْدًا اَوْ لَاۡاَذْبَحَنَّهٗۤ اَوْ لَیَاْتِیَنِّیْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: I will inflict a severe punishment on him or maybe even slaughter him unless he comes forth with a convincing reason (for his absence)."

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَكَثَ غَیْرَ بَعِیْدٍ فَقَالَ اَحَطْتُّ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهٖ وَ جِئْتُكَ مِنْ سَبَاٍۭ بِنَبَاٍ یَّقِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: Not before long the hoopoe came up and said: "I have obtained a knowledge which you could not. I have brought for you sure news about Sheba.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ وَجَدْتُّ امْرَاَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَ اُوْتِیَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَّ لَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: I found there a woman ruling over them, one who has been endowed with all things and has a mighty throne.

ayahs.arabicText: وَجَدْتُّهَا وَ قَوْمَهَا یَسْجُدُوْنَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَ زَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّیْطٰنُ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِیْلِ فَهُمْ لَا یَهْتَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: I found that she and her people prostrate themselves before the sun rather than Allah. " Satan has made their deeds appear attractive to them and has, thus, debarred them from the Right Path so they do not find true guidance

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّا یَسْجُدُوْا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ یُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ یَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُوْنَ وَ مَا تُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: that they would prostrate themselves before Allah Who brings to light all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ۩ ۞
ayahs.translation: Allah - none is worthy of worship save He; He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ سَنَنْظُرُ اَصَدَقْتَ اَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Solomon said: "Soon shall we see whether you have spoken the truth or are one of those that lie.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْهَبْ بِّكِتٰبِیْ هٰذَا فَاَلْقِهْ اِلَیْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ مَا ذَا یَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Take this letter of mine, deliver it to them, and then draw back from them, and observe what they do."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَتْ یٰۤاَیُّهَا الْمَلَؤُا اِنِّیْۤ اُلْقِیَ اِلَیَّ كِتٰبٌ كَرِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: The Queen said:" Know my nobles that a gracious letter has been delivered to me.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهٗ مِنْ سُلَیْمٰنَ وَ اِنَّهٗ بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: It is from Solomon, and it is: "In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate."

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّا تَعْلُوْا عَلَیَّ وَ اْتُوْنِیْ مُسْلِمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: (It says): "Do not act towards me with defiance, but come to me in submission."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَتْ یٰۤاَیُّهَا الْمَلَؤُا اَفْتُوْنِیْ فِیْۤ اَمْرِیْ١ۚ مَا كُنْتُ قَاطِعَةً اَمْرًا حَتّٰى تَشْهَدُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: (After reading the letter) the Queen said: "Nobles, let me have your counsel in this matter for I make no firm decision without you."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا نَحْنُ اُولُوْا قُوَّةٍ وَّ اُولُوْا بَاْسٍ شَدِیْدٍ١ۙ۬ وَّ الْاَمْرُ اِلَیْكِ فَانْظُرِیْ مَا ذَا تَاْمُرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "We are strong and are given to vehement fighting. But the decision is yours. Therefore, consider what you would like to command."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَتْ اِنَّ الْمُلُوْكَ اِذَا دَخَلُوْا قَرْیَةً اَفْسَدُوْهَا وَ جَعَلُوْۤا اَعِزَّةَ اَهْلِهَاۤ اَذِلَّةً١ۚ وَ كَذٰلِكَ یَفْعَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Queen said: "When the kings enter a country they cause corruption in it and abase those of its people who are held in honour. This is what they are wont to do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنِّیْ مُرْسِلَةٌ اِلَیْهِمْ بِهَدِیَّةٍ فَنٰظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ یَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: I will send them a gift and then see with what answer my envoys return."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَیْمٰنَ قَالَ اَتُمِدُّوْنَنِ بِمَالٍ١٘ فَمَاۤ اٰتٰىنَِۧ اللّٰهُ خَیْرٌ مِّمَّاۤ اٰتٰىكُمْ١ۚ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ بِهَدِیَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Now, when (the envoy of the Queen) came to Solomon, he said: "Do you want to aid me with wealth? Whatever Allah has granted me is much more than what He has given you. (Keep for yourselves) your gift in which you are exulting.

ayahs.arabicText: اِرْجِعْ اِلَیْهِمْ فَلَنَاْتِیَنَّهُمْ بِجُنُوْدٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَ لَنُخْرِجَنَّهُمْ مِّنْهَاۤ اَذِلَّةً وَّ هُمْ صٰغِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Envoy, go back to those who sent you and we shall certainly come upon them with hosts whom they will be unable to resist. We shall drive them out from there, and they will suffer humiliation and disgrace."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰۤاَیُّهَا الْمَلَؤُا اَیُّكُمْ یَاْتِیْنِیْ بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ اَنْ یَّاْتُوْنِیْ مُسْلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Solomon said: "My nobles, which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ عِفْرِیْتٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ اَنَا اٰتِیْكَ بِهٖ قَبْلَ اَنْ تَقُوْمَ مِنْ مَّقَامِكَ١ۚ وَ اِنِّیْ عَلَیْهِ لَقَوِیٌّ اَمِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: A stalwart of the jinn said: "I will bring it to you before you rise from your council. Surely I have the power to do so and I am trustworthy."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ الَّذِیْ عِنْدَهٗ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ اَنَا اٰتِیْكَ بِهٖ قَبْلَ اَنْ یَّرْتَدَّ اِلَیْكَ طَرْفُكَ١ؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِنْدَهٗ قَالَ هٰذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّیْ١ۖ۫ لِیَبْلُوَنِیْۤ ءَاَشْكُرُ اَمْ اَكْفُرُ١ؕ وَ مَنْ شَكَرَ فَاِنَّمَا یَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهٖ١ۚ وَ مَنْ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ رَبِّیْ غَنِیٌّ كَرِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And he who had some knowledge of the Book said: "I will bring it before the twinkling of your eye." When Solomon saw the throne placed firmly beside him, he cried out: "This is by the grace of my Lord so that He may test me whether I give thanks for (His Bounty) or act with ingratitude. Whoever is grateful is so to his own good; and whoever is ungrateful, let him know that my Lord is Immensely Resourceful, Most Bountiful."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ نَكِّرُوْا لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنْظُرْ اَتَهْتَدِیْۤ اَمْ تَكُوْنُ مِنَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Solomon said: " Set the throne before her casually, and let us see whether she gets to the Truth or is one of those who are not guided to what is right."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِیْلَ اَهٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ١ؕ قَالَتْ كَاَنَّهٗ هُوَ١ۚ وَ اُوْتِیْنَا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا وَ كُنَّا مُسْلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: When the Queen arrived, she was asked: "Is your throne like this one?" She said: "It seems as if it is the same. We had already come to know this and we had submitted ourselves."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ صَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتْ تَّعْبُدُ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: What prevented her (from accepting the True Faith) was her worshipping deities other than Allah, for she belonged to an unbelieving people.

ayahs.arabicText: قِیْلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِی الصَّرْحَ١ۚ فَلَمَّا رَاَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَّ كَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَیْهَا١ؕ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّنْ قَوَارِیْرَ١ؕ۬ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِیْ وَ اَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَیْمٰنَ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: She was told: "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a pool of water and she bared both her calves (to enter into it). Solomon said: "This is a slippery floor of crystal." Thereupon she cried out: "My Lord, I have been inflicting much wrong on myself. Now I submit myself with Solomon to Allah, the Lord of the whole Universe."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَاۤ اِلٰى ثَمُوْدَ اَخَاهُمْ صٰلِحًا اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ فَاِذَا هُمْ فَرِیْقٰنِ یَخْتَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We sent to Thamud their brother Salih (with the Message): "Serve Allah," but all of a sudden they became split into two quarrelling factions.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ بِالسَّیِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ١ۚ لَوْ لَا تَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Salih said: "My people, why do you wish to hasten that evil rather than good should come upon you? Why should you not seek pardon from Allah so that mercy be shown to you?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوا اطَّیَّرْنَا بِكَ وَ بِمَنْ مَّعَكَ١ؕ قَالَ طٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "We augur ill of you and those who are with you." Salih replied: "Your augury is with Allah. The truth is that you are a people who are being tried."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَانَ فِی الْمَدِیْنَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ یُّفْسِدُوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ لَا یُصْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Now there were nine ring-leaders in the city who created corruption in the land and never worked to set things right.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا تَقَاسَمُوْا بِاللّٰهِ لَنُبَیِّتَنَّهٗ وَ اَهْلَهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَقُوْلَنَّ لِوَلِیِّهٖ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ اَهْلِهٖ وَ اِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "Swear to one another in the name of Allah that we shall make a sudden night swoop on Salih and his family and will then tell their heirs that we did not witness the destruction of his family. We are indeed truthful."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَكَرُوْا مَكْرًا وَّ مَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَّ هُمْ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thus they planned and We too planned, the while they did not know.

ayahs.arabicText: فَانْظُرْ كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ١ۙ اَنَّا دَمَّرْنٰهُمْ وَ قَوْمَهُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So see what was the outcome of the plan they made: We utterly destroyed them and their people, all of them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتِلْكَ بُیُوْتُهُمْ خَاوِیَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوْا١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً لِّقَوْمٍ یَّعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Now behold their houses that lie in utter ruins because of their wrong-doing. Verily there is a Sign in this for the people who know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْجَیْنَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ كَانُوْا یَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We delivered those who believed and were wont to avoid disobeying (Allah).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لُوْطًا اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهٖۤ اَتَاْتُوْنَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَ اَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We also sent Lot, and recall when he told his people: "Do you commit shameless acts with your eyes open?

ayahs.arabicText: اَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَاْتُوْنَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّنْ دُوْنِ النِّسَآءِ١ؕ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do you lustfully approach men instead of women? Nay, you engage in acts of sheer ignorance."

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهٖۤ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ قَالُوْۤا اَخْرِجُوْۤا اٰلَ لُوْطٍ مِّنْ قَرْیَتِكُمْ١ۚ اِنَّهُمْ اُنَاسٌ یَّتَطَهَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But this had only one answer from his people. They said: "Expel Lot's folk from your city. They pretend to be absolutely clean."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَنْجَیْنٰهُ وَ اَهْلَهٗۤ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهٗ١٘ قَدَّرْنٰهَا مِنَ الْغٰبِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Eventually We saved (Lot) and his family, except his wife. We had decreed that she should be among those who would remain behind.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمْطَرْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ مَّطَرًا١ۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِیْنَ۠
ayahs.translation: And We rained down upon them a rain. It was an evil rain for those who had already been warned.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَ سَلٰمٌ عَلٰى عِبَادِهِ الَّذِیْنَ اصْطَفٰى١ؕ آٰللّٰهُ خَیْرٌ اَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَؕ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Say, (O Muhammad): "All praise be to Allah, and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen." (Ask them): "Who is better: Allah or the false gods that they associate with Him as His partners?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ اَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً١ۚ فَاَنْۢبَتْنَا بِهٖ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ١ۚ مَا كَانَ لَكُمْ اَنْ تُنْۢبِتُوْا شَجَرَهَا١ؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ یَّعْدِلُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky and then We caused to grow therewith orchards full of beauty whose trees you could never grow. Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)?" Nay, they are a people who are veering away from the Right Path.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّنْ جَعَلَ الْاَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَّ جَعَلَ خِلٰلَهَاۤ اَنْهٰرًا وَّ جَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِیَ وَ جَعَلَ بَیْنَ الْبَحْرَیْنِ حَاجِزًا١ؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Who is it Who has made the earth a place of resort, and has caused rivers to flow in its midst, and has placed upon it firm mountains, and has placed a barrier between two masses of water? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Nay; but most of them do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّنْ یُّجِیْبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ اِذَا دَعَاهُ وَ یَكْشِفُ السُّوْٓءَ وَ یَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ قَلِیْلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Who is it Who heeds the prayers of the distressed when he calls out to Him and Who removes his affliction? And who is it Who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? How little do you reflect!

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّنْ یَّهْدِیْكُمْ فِیْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ وَ مَنْ یُّرْسِلُ الرِّیٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَیْنَ یَدَیْ رَحْمَتِهٖ١ؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ تَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Who is it Who guides you through the darkness on land and sea? And Who sends winds as heralds of good tidings ahead of His Mercy? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate with Him in His Divinity!

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّنْ یَّبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ یُعِیْدُهٗ وَ مَنْ یَّرْزُقُكُمْ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ قُلْ هَاتُوْا بُرْهَانَكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who is it Who creates in the first instance and then repeats it? Who is it Who provides you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Say: "Bring forth your evidence, if you are truthful."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ لَّا یَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ الْغَیْبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ١ؕ وَ مَا یَشْعُرُوْنَ اَیَّانَ یُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say: "None in the heavens or on the earth has knowledge of the Unseen save Allah. They do not know when they will be raised to life."

ayahs.arabicText: بَلِ ادّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ١۫ بَلْ هُمْ فِیْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا١۫٘ بَلْ هُمْ مِّنْهَا عَمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Nay, but they have lost their knowledge of the Hereafter. They are steeped in doubt and uncertainty about it: rather they are blind to it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا تُرٰبًا وَّ اٰبَآؤُنَاۤ اَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers say: "When we become dust, we and our forefathers, shall we really be brought out (from our graves)?

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هٰذَا نَحْنُ وَ اٰبَآؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ١ۙ اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اَسَاطِیْرُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We were told about this and so were our forefathers before us. But these are no more than fairy tales that have been recounted from ancient times."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ سِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say: "Go about through the earth and see what has been the end of the evil-doers."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ لَا تَكُنْ فِیْ ضَیْقٍ مِّمَّا یَمْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), do not grieve over them, nor be distressed at their designs.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They also say: "Tell us when this threat will come to pass, if you are truthful."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ عَسٰۤى اَنْ یَّكُوْنَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِیْ تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say: "The chastisement whose hastening you have been asking for, maybe a part of it has drawn quite near to you."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوْ فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا یَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed Your Lord is exceedingly bountiful to mankind. Yet most of them do not give thanks.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَیَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُوْرُهُمْ وَ مَا یُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Verily your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal as well as all that they reveal.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍ فِی السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا فِیْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: There is nothing that is hidden - be it in the heaven or the earth - but is recorded in a Clear Book.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ یَقُصُّ عَلٰى بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ اَكْثَرَ الَّذِیْ هُمْ فِیْهِ یَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely this Qur'an explains to the Children of Israel most of the matters concerning which they have disagreements

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهٗ لَهُدًى وَّ رَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and it is a guidance and mercy for the believers.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ یَقْضِیْ بَیْنَهُمْ بِحُكْمِهٖ١ۚ وَ هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْعَلِیْمُۙۚ
ayahs.translation: Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. He is All-Mighty, All-Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِیْنِ
ayahs.translation: So put your trust in Allah for you are on the manifest truth.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰى وَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely you cannot make the dead hear you, nor can you make the deaf hear your call if they turn back in flight,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَنْتَ بِهٰدِی الْعُمْیِ عَنْ ضَلٰلَتِهِمْ١ؕ اِنْ تُسْمِعُ اِلَّا مَنْ یُّؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَا فَهُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: nor can you direct the blind to the Right Way, preventing them from falling into error. You can make only those who believe in Our verses to hear the call and then submit.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَیْهِمْ اَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ١ۙ اَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا لَا یُوْقِنُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And when the time for the fulfilment of Our Word against them will come, We shall bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them because people did not believe in Our Signs.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِنْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِّمَّنْ یُّكَذِّبُ بِاٰیٰتِنَا فَهُمْ یُوْزَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Just imagine the Day when We shall muster from every nation a large group of those who gave the lie to Our Signs, and they shall be duly arranged in ranks

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءُوْ قَالَ اَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِاٰیٰتِیْ وَ لَمْ تُحِیْطُوْا بِهَا عِلْمًا اَمَّا ذَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: until, when all of them have arrived, Allah will say: "Did you give the lie to My Signs even without encompassing them with your knowledge? If that is not so, what did you do?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَیْهِمْ بِمَا ظَلَمُوْا فَهُمْ لَا یَنْطِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the Word will come to pass against them because of their wrong-doing: they will then be able to utter nothing.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ یَرَوْا اَنَّا جَعَلْنَا الَّیْلَ لِیَسْكُنُوْا فِیْهِ وَ النَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Did they not perceive that We had made the night so that they may repose in it and made the day clear and shining. Surely there are Signs in this for those who believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یُنْفَخُ فِی الصُّوْرِ فَفَزِعَ مَنْ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَنْ فِی الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا مَنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ١ؕ وَ كُلٌّ اَتَوْهُ دٰخِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown all those who are in the heavens and on the earth shall be terror stricken - all except those whom Allah wills - and everyone shall come to Him utterly abject.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَرَى الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَّ هِیَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ١ؕ صُنْعَ اللّٰهِ الَّذِیْۤ اَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ خَبِیْرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: You now see the mountains and consider them firmly fixed, but then they shall pass away even as clouds pass away. That will be the handiwork of Allah Who has created everything with perfect wisdom. He is well aware of what you do.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ جَآءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ خَیْرٌ مِّنْهَا١ۚ وَ هُمْ مِّنْ فَزَعٍ یَّوْمَئِذٍ اٰمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Whosoever comes with good will receive a reward better than his deed, and they will be made secure from the terror of that Day.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ جَآءَ بِالسَّیِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوْهُهُمْ فِی النَّارِ١ؕ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And whosoever comes with evil, they will be flung upon their faces into the Fire. Will you be recompensed for aught other than what you do?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَاۤ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِیْ حَرَّمَهَا وَ لَهٗ كُلُّ شَیْءٍ١٘ وَّ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (Tell them, O Muhammad): "I have been commanded only to serve the Lord of this city that He has made inviolable, to serve Him to Whom all things belong. I have been commanded to be of those that submit to Allah,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْ اَتْلُوَا الْقُرْاٰنَ١ۚ فَمَنِ اهْتَدٰى فَاِنَّمَا یَهْتَدِیْ لِنَفْسِهٖ١ۚ وَ مَنْ ضَلَّ فَقُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and to recite the Qur'an." So, whosoever is guided, his guidance will be to his own good. As for those who stray, tell them: "I am none but a warner."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ سَیُرِیْكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ فَتَعْرِفُوْنَهَا١ؕ وَ مَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And say: "All praise be to Allah, Who will soon show you His Signs that you will recognize." Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
